overview: This one-page Department of State list of papers records a single communication from Reed at Taihoku, dated August 15, 1931, concerning the Railway Department’s consideration of methods to increase railway revenue in Taiwan. It is an index or cover sheet rather than the substantive report itself and identifies the broader file subject as Formosan railway concessions, construction, and equipment.

people.name: Reed
people.role: Sender of the listed report from Taihoku

subfiles.title: List of Papers Entry for Reed’s Report on Taiwan Railway Revenue
subfiles.about: The sheet registers a report on methods considered by the Railway Department for increasing railway revenue in Taiwan.
subfiles.summary: This Department of State filing sheet contains one entry under decimal classification 894A.77. It records a communication from Reed at Taihoku to “FE EA,” dated August 15, 1931, reporting on the Railway Department’s consideration of ways to increase revenue in Taiwan. The underlying report is not included in the supplied page.

interest: The page is useful chiefly as a finding aid: it establishes the existence, date, origin, destination, and subject of a report that is not itself present here. For historians of Japanese colonial Taiwan, it points to official concern with the finances of the island’s railway system in 1931 and situates that concern within U.S. diplomatic reporting and State Department filing practices.
